_comment: Project fidelity config for the SPX mobile 虚拟币存款 (Crypto Deposit) phone screen 790:15656. Same tolerances/gate as home/accounts/cards.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; impl ships SC variant + Plus Jakarta Sans. Same Huawei family.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock only — every other text on the figma frame is a literal label or fixed seed (address string / 1 USDT / 3次网络确认), so we don't waive content.
